## What it is

The ring, the four bars, and the disc, in place, with the tube. Not exported as its own STL.

## Design notes

- 14 openings. 72.90 mm of the 965.2 mm tube is straight. The helix is 892.30 mm, exactly 3.25 turns, so it starts in the first opening and the cut end is the centre of the last.
- Blue 1 has four, including the lowest. Yellow 2 has four, including the highest. Green 3 has three. Orange 4 has three.
- The mouths face outward. The ring and the disc sit in curved slots. Tabs on the ring flank each bar.
- The ring is Ø117.2 with a Ø98.4 hole, 2.4 mm thick. The disc is Ø89.4 with a Ø84.6 hole, 1.2 mm thick.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't mix these towers with the necked set. Those bores are in a different place.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: openings cut into the bar. No necks. Ring and cap unchanged.
